# Changelog

## 0.1.0

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation.
- Direct dense Frisch-Newton and constrained Frisch-Newton solver port.
- Multiple-quantile, weighted, lasso, SCAD and large-n preprocessing APIs.
- Local and nonlinear quantile regression APIs.
- Quantile selection/types 1--9 and bootstrap/numerical utilities.
- Strict GNU Fortran regression suite and standalone examples.
